title: +*PRINCIPLES OF BIOLOGY: CELLS
description: Explores fundamental biological concepts and theories about the cellular and molecular basis of life including cell structure and function, metabolism, genetic basis of inheritance and how information flows from DNA to proteins, with a focus on the iterative process of science. Intended for science majors.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CH 121*, 121NL* or 201* or ((CH 221Z*, 221HZ*, 231* or 231H*) and (CH 227Z*, 227HZ*, 261*, 261H* or 271*)).
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D- is required in CH 121, CH 121NL, CH 201, CH 221Z, CH 221HZ, CH 231, CH 231H, CH 227Z, CH 227HZ, CH 261, CH 261H and CH 271.
